interpretation: Formal statements are comparators: they pin down exactly what a proof or counterexample must establish. Core Lean 4 only, no Mathlib, no sorry; every kernel-checked theorem is also registered in data/lean_targets.json and axiom-audited by the Lean proof gate. Kernel-checked results are finite fidelity tests inside known mathematics, never progress on the open statement.

fidelity_levels.author_checked: Encoding written and checked against the registry statement by its author; fidelity examples compile.
fidelity_levels.independently_reviewed: A second reviewer has compared every definition with a primary source.

entries.encodes: Every even n ≥ 4 is p + (n − p) with both prime; primes by trial division.
not_encoded: Bounds on the least Goldbach prime

kernel_checked.claim: The statement holds for every even 4 ≤ n ≤ 1000 (least-prime witness table re-checked by the kernel).

entries.encodes: 4/n = 1/x + 1/y + 1/z cleared to 4xyz = n(xy + yz + zx) with x, y, z > 0.

kernel_checked.claim: Explicit positive solutions for every 2 ≤ n ≤ 100, re-checked by the kernel.

entries.encodes: Loopless digraph on n vertices, minimum out-degree ≥ r ≥ 1, has an injective directed cycle of length ≤ ⌈n/r⌉; StatementFor r fixes the out-degree slice.
not_encoded: The triangle case r = n/3 separately

entries.encodes: Families as bitmasks over ground set {0,…,k−1}; union-closed with a nonempty member implies some x with 2·deg(x) ≥ |F|.

kernel_checked.claim: Exhaustive over all 2, 16 and 256 families on ground sets of size 1, 2, 3 (ground_1, ground_2, ground_3).

entries.encodes: Every simple graph has a K_t minor (branch-set model, connectivity by no-split cuts) or a proper (t−1)-colouring.
Simple graphs on n ≥ 3 vertices with a deck-matching bijection σ (G − v ≅ H − σv) are isomorphic.
For every k ≥ 1 an Int matrix of order 4k with ±1 entries and pairwise orthogonal rows.

kernel_checked.claim: Explicit Hadamard matrices of orders 4, 8, 16 (Sylvester) and 12 (Paley), re-checked by the kernel (order_4, order_8, order_12, order_16).

entries.encodes: Arrows n s t: every red/blue colouring of K_n has a red K_s or a blue K_t (cliques as vertex bitmasks). Conjecture: Arrows 43 5 5.
not_encoded: The known bounds ¬Arrows 42 5 5 and Arrows 46 5 5 are cited, not re-proved

kernel_checked.claim: R(3,3) > 5: the pentagon colouring has no monochromatic triangle.

entries.encodes: No incidence relation on 157 points and 157 lines with 13 points per line, unique joining lines and unique meeting points.

kernel_checked.claim: The axioms are satisfiable: planes of orders 2 (Fano) and 3 exist (exists_order_2, exists_order_3).
